correctness.rationale: Under the source's fitting assumptions, adding the printed \(H\) and \(R\) equations gives \(\dot H+\dot R=(\delta+\gamma)I\). The source independently defines \(I\) as non-confirmed and \(\delta I\) as the confirmation transition, so the model-consistent cumulative confirmation counter must satisfy \(\dot C=\delta I\). Integration gives the exact ratio. The numerical values are direct arithmetic from the published fitted parameters and initial conditions.

value.rationale: The source's least-squares calibration and its central cumulative-confirmed forecast use the affected observable. The discrepancy is not a cosmetic label: with the published parameters the wrong observable accumulates post-start cases about \(10.0763\%\) faster on every fixed trajectory. The result gives an exact repair target—an added counter with inflow \(\delta I\)—while clearly separating internal consistency from a new epidemiological fit.
